title: Bearfoot By The Sea | KEY.co
description_expanded: Beyond its luxurious interiors, the property is perfectly positioned for beachside living. A short 300-foot stroll takes you to pristine sands, while the included six-seater golf cart and adult bikes make it easy to explore the nearby attractions along Scenic 30A. After a day of sun and sea, retreat to one of the beautifully appointed bedrooms, including two primary suites, each with its own full-sized washer and dryer for ultimate convenience. The multi-level rooftop terrace stands out as the crown jewel of this home, offering stunning sunset views and a well-equipped wet bar ideal for entertaining. With nearby dining options ranging from fine dining at Cafe Thirty-A to casual bites at Angelina’s Pizzeria, this Seagrove Beach haven is the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience, ensuring a vacation experience like no other. Experience unparalleled luxury in this exquisite six-bedroom, six-and-a-half-bathroom retreat, nestled in the charming Seagrove Beach community, just steps from Hickory Beach. Designed to accommodate up to 16 guests, this stunning four-story home offers breathtaking Gulf views from its rooftop terrace, where 360-degree panoramas of Seaside and Seagrove create the perfect backdrop for unforgettable gatherings. Inside, every detail has been thoughtfully curated, from the natural light-filled first floor with its cozy sitting area and shuffleboard table to the inviting second-floor great room adorned with shiplap walls and cypress ceiling accents. Whether you’re savoring a meal in the gourmet kitchen, unwinding by the private pool, or relaxing on the balcony swing, this home promises a delightful escape filled with comfort and elegance.
